classification_rule: MPI/UCX if any frame resolves to libmpi, libmpifort, libuct, libucp or libucs. Otherwise exclusive leaf categories by symbol prefix: scalar storage/addressing, native inverse own leaves (including copy_values route helper), other block interfaces, Domain boundary own leaves, construction, memory alloc/copy/zero, observer, other. Inline frames retained. Inclusive ancestry used only for route identification, not added to leaves.
scope: Sample-derived ratios are for the same seven selected ranks over eleven ordinary steps at fixed event period; not a node-wide unbiased estimate or exact per-function wall savings. PMU counts include MPI spinning.
conclusion: Strong evidence for excess representation/data-movement work and MPI progress amplification; no large universal per-instruction slowdown. Wavelet non-MPI CPI and demand-fill counts retain memory evidence. Complete inverse staging and scalar storage paths are source-backed candidates; >=0.10 s wall recovery is not yet demonstrated.
